#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
exec > >(tee /var/log/openclaw-bootstrap.log > /dev/console) 2>&1
echo "[oc:bootstrap] starting immutable init-host download"
export OC_BOOTSTRAP_AMP_REMOTE_WRITE_URL="none"
export OC_BOOTSTRAP_AGENTCORE_GATEWAY_URL="none"
_install_packages() {
  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
  apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=60 update -qq
  apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=60 install -y -qq "$@" >/dev/null
}
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || _install_packages ca-certificates curl
TOKEN=$(curl -fsS -X PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 300')
imds() { curl -fsS -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: ${TOKEN}" "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/$1"; }
REGION=$(imds placement/region)
INSTANCE_ID=$(imds instance-id)
_abandon() {
  rc=$?; trap - EXIT
  [ -z "${tmp:-}" ] || rm -f "$tmp" || true
  [ -z "${staged:-}" ] || rm -f "$staged" || true
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    aws autoscaling complete-lifecycle-action --lifecycle-hook-name openclaw-host-init --auto-scaling-group-name openclaw-hosts-asg --lifecycle-action-result ABANDON --instance-id "${INSTANCE_ID}" --region "${REGION}" || true
  fi
  exit "$rc"
}
trap _abandon EXIT
if ! command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1 || _install_packages unzip
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64|amd64) AWSCLI_ARCH=x86_64 ;;
    aarch64|arm64) AWSCLI_ARCH=aarch64 ;;
    *) echo '[oc:bootstrap] FATAL: unsupported CPU architecture'; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  curl -fsSL "https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-${AWSCLI_ARCH}.zip" -o /tmp/awscliv2.zip
  (cd /tmp && unzip -qo awscliv2.zip && ./aws/install)
fi
tmp=$(mktemp /tmp/init-host.XXXXXX)
for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do
  if aws s3 cp "s3://

/deployment/bootstrap/host/dea0bd3d54ac88764319c07b1b546df952e8e828f7f3aba0d18866160ee2d046/init-host.sh" "$tmp" --region "$REGION" --no-progress; then break; fi
  [ "$attempt" -lt 20 ] || exit 1
  sleep 15
done
printf '%s  %s\n' 'dea0bd3d54ac88764319c07b1b546df952e8e828f7f3aba0d18866160ee2d046' "$tmp" | sha256sum -c -
staged=/var/lib/cloud/.init-host.sh.$$
install -o root -g root -m 0700 "$tmp" "$staged"
mv -f "$staged" /var/lib/cloud/init-host.sh
rm -f "$tmp"
echo "[oc:bootstrap] verified init-host dea0bd3d54ac88764319c07b1b546df952e8e828f7f3aba0d18866160ee2d046, executing"
exec bash /var/lib/cloud/init-host.sh

#!/bin/bash
set -x
dnf install -y docker jq || yum install -y docker jq
mkdir -p /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins
ARCH=$(uname -m); [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ] && CARCH=aarch64 || CARCH=x86_64
curl -sL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-linux-$CARCH" -o /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose && chmod +x /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
systemctl enable --now docker
mkdir -p /opt/litellm && cd /opt/litellm
for i in $(seq 1 60); do aws s3 cp s3://

/deployment/litellm/ . --recursive --region us-east-1 2>/dev/null; [ -f docker-compose.litellm.yml ] && [ -f litellm-config.yaml ] && break; echo "waiting for litellm assets in S3 ($i)"; sleep 10; done
set +x
MK=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id openclaw-litellm-us-east-1 --region us-east-1 --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .master_key)
echo "LITELLM_MASTER_KEY=$MK" > .env
echo "POSTGRES_USER=litellm" >> .env
echo "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=$MK" >> .env
echo "POSTGRES_DB=litellm" >> .env
echo "DATABASE_URL=postgresql://litellm:$MK@litellm-db:5432/litellm" >> .env
chmod 600 .env
set -x
GR_ID=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /openclaw/bedrock-guardrail-id --region us-east-1 --query "Parameter.Value" --output text 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ -n "$GR_ID" ]; then echo "[litellm-userdata] guardrail enabled id: $GR_ID"; sed "s|__GUARDRAIL_ID__|${GR_ID}|g" litellm-config.yaml > config.runtime.yaml; else echo "[litellm-userdata] no guardrail id in SSM — running WITHOUT bedrock guardrail"; sed "/^guardrails:/,\$d" litellm-config.yaml > config.runtime.yaml; fi
if grep -q "__GUARDRAIL_ID__" config.runtime.yaml; then echo "[litellm-userdata][ERR] guardrail placeholder not replaced" >&2; exit 1; fi
sed -i 's|^\(\s*master_key:\).*|\1 os.environ/LITELLM_MASTER_KEY|' config.runtime.yaml || true
docker compose --profile embedded-db -f docker-compose.litellm.yml up -d 2>&1 | tail -5
set +x
TOK=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 300")
IP=$(curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOK" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/local-ipv4)
aws ssm put-parameter --name /openclaw/litellm-host --type String --overwrite --value "http://$IP:4000/v1" --region us-east-1
set -x
